correctedExplanation: -size NM tests ceil(bytes / 1,048,576) = N. +NM tests a rounded count greater than N. A c suffix uses exact one-byte units. A positive-byte file smaller than 1 MiB can still match 1M.

problem.question: New boundary: which files match command A, the 1M rounded bucket?
